Perched on the Gulf of Mexico coastline, Seaside is picturesque beach perfection. Enjoy community pools, the famous Seaside Town Square, and carefully designed beach pavilions. Guests will love relaxing on the porch swing or sipping lemonade on the covered upstairs balcony of this home—only a short walk from the beach!Discover a serene coastal getaway upon arrival at this 2-story home. A large front porch with 2 classic porch swings invites guests to unwind in the salty air. There is a charcoal grill conveniently off the footpath, perfect for a lunchtime cookout! There are rocking chairs and a table for alfresco dining on each balcony.Outdoor spaces and a delightful location in Seaside make Suite Magnolia I & II an excellent location for a relaxed getaway. body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seaside "Suite Magnolia I & II" 640 Forest Street Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 4 Beds 4 Sleeps 9 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 2 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Short walk to the beach, community pools, and amenities - Steps from the famous Seaside Town Square featuring plenty of shopping and dining - 2 Charcoal grills - 4 adult bikes - 2 dedicated parking spots - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Sleeping up to 9 guests in charming Seaside, Suite Magnolia I & II are 2 side-by-side homes that feature 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms collectively. Perched on the Gulf of Mexico coastline, Seaside is picturesque beach perfection. Enjoy community pools, the famous Seaside Town Square, and carefully designed beach pavilions. Guests will love relaxing on the porch swing or sipping lemonade on the covered upstairs balcony of this home—only a short walk from the beach! Discover a serene coastal getaway upon arrival at this 2-story home. A large front porch with 2 classic porch swings invites guests to unwind in the salty air. There is a charcoal grill conveniently off the footpath, perfect for a lunchtime cookout! Inside, there are 4 guest bedrooms with private bathrooms on the bottom floor—3 have queen beds, and 1 has a full bed and a twin trundle. Up on the top floors, guests will find an airy great room with high windows, tons of natural light, and multiple doors to the spacious balcony. The eat-in kitchens come with high-end appliances and tables for 6. Both living spaces have a TV and plenty of soft seating for guests to gather together. There are rocking chairs and a table for alfresco dining on each balcony. Outdoor spaces and a delightful location in Seaside make Suite Magnolia I & II an excellent location for a relaxed getaway. There is parking for 1 vehicle—plus 2 complimentary adult bikes—making it easy to explore the area at a leisurely pace. Book these lovely homes today!
